items.scope: Introduction and continuous exterior-calculus framework, pp.1–8
items.checks: Read definitions, form degrees, Hodge/codifferential signs and Green identity. Symmetric Jacobian sufficient for the variational conservation law; fiber domain is a vector space for the Poincare argument. Exact one-dimensional Green identity independently checked.

Initial constant-field algebra is correct for unrestricted nonsymmetric linear media, but focused acceptance read the Hodge definition on p3 and the full p9 qualification: tensors are identified with Hodge operators and (16) assumes symmetry. The nonsymmetric example lies outside those assumptions. Former P4 is therefore a scope clarification, not a counted mathematical defect.

items.scope: Weak spaces, jumps/averages and formulation, pp.9–14
items.checks: Full read of function spaces, product/locality, L2 trace assumptions, linear flux and C1 source, omitted external boundary conditions, and precise linearized variation equations. Exact two-sided jump-average identity checked. External weak trace theorem not independently reproved.

Tracked antisymmetric trace pairing, cancellation using f' symmetry, admissible trace tests and interior-facet signs. Distinguished local multisymplecticity from strong conservation; strong conservativity alone insufficient.

items.scope: AFW hybridization, Theorem4.1, Theorem4.3, Lemma4.4 and Proposition4.6, pp.17–20
items.checks: Riesz representation on trace quotient, tangential equality, 1D special case, two-equilateral-simplex construction, k=n strong conservation. BDM full-polynomial trace degree differs from trimmed RT degree; conclusion survives corrected spaces. Family-level failure not asserted for every individual Hamiltonian/mesh.

items.scope: LDG-H Theorem4.9 and scalar/vector methods, pp.20–23
items.checks: General bounded symmetric facet penalties, constant and projected penalties, local symmetry and range inclusions. Read all stated scalar/vector spaces. No PDE convergence/stability or named implementation equivalence independently replicated.
Checked alpha*beta=1, interior/boundary jump conventions and transformation. Piecewise boundary formula omits alpha*z_tan; preceding equation and proof use correct expression.

items.scope: IP-H Theorem4.17 and primal forms, pp.25–28
items.checks: Test-space requirements dW,deltaW, symmetry of residual pairings, conservation inclusions, inverse penalty signs and boundary assumptions. Coercivity not established by the review.

items.scope: Reduced trace spaces and Theorem4.21, pp.28–30
items.checks: Projection can destroy symmetry of a general penalty. Constructed a complete one-triangle polynomial-space counterexample to the W_nor subset M branch, using bounded symmetric strictly positive facet penalty; all weak/variation equations and bracket -1/210 checked exactly. Tangential-containment branch and standard commuting scalar penalties remain supported.

Read full first-order/primal relations; checked symmetric penalty/test-orthogonality proof and strong-conservation cancellations. Cited corner-singularity consistency and commuting-element literature not independently reproved.
